svg.title: Same Value. Different records.
svg.desc: Observed public lines for one Rayls testnet deposit, two public withdrawals and five transactions with shielded spends.
svg.text: All 8 sampled transactions showed native Value = 0.
Receipt also has an encrypted note.
The payment amount is not listed.
Notes in the separate fee call.
The token log answers the amount question.
Value = 0 and an encrypted note can also appear in a public deposit or exit.
